scope: Reference sufficiency for complete housing; no replacement design or print released.

sources.note: Byte-identical to the 2024 HAT download at https://dl.radxa.com/zero3/docs/hw/3e/ra023_pcba.stp.zip

sources.requirement: Keep metal screws and copper pillars installed and tightened; they carry the PoE electrical connection.

source_cad_mm.limits: Source geometry, not measured owner hardware or a manufacturing tolerance. Some source leaves are surface compounds. The supplied CAD omits mounting hardware and cooling accessories.

pillars.description: M2.5 x 14.5 copper pillars with insulating heat-shrink tubing

screws.description: CM2.5 x 4; assembly narrative also says CM2.5 x 4 x 4 without defining head dimensions

unresolved: Actual HAT revision, fan and heatsink configuration.
Actual mated PCB gap: CAD says 18 mm; package lists 14.5 mm pillars. Neither source establishes which spacing applies to owner hardware.
Screw-head diameter and protruding height, insulated pillar diameter, and complete assembly outer height.
Fan fasteners, wire route and fitted heatsinks omitted from CAD.

cold_reference_review.conclusion: Independent STEP inspection reproduced the 18 mm PCB gap, missing hardware and 706.260 mm3 interference if the HAT is lowered to a 14.5 mm gap. Verified full-module and support/keepout envelopes remain necessary; lower-PCB edge retention could avoid requiring exact fastener head geometry.
